findings.title: Marriage overview is missing
findings.prototype: admin-case-marriage.html:67-162: outside-Coptic ceremony, dates, priest, church/location/diocese, certificate number/issue date and contextual documents.
findings.implementation: Council app.js:1246-1255 disables Marriage; council implementation notes explicitly say no projection. Case detail lacks these facts.
findings.schema_mapping: marriages + application_marriage_assertions + application_answers/additional_facts + file_context_links. Current Case.marriage_date is not the full record. Certificate issue date needs an explicit question/field mapping.
findings.action: Build source-attributed council marriage projection/view and exact contextual document links. Separate spouse assertions from findings; do not invent a table per page.

findings.title: Separation overview is missing
findings.prototype: admin-case-separation.html:92-279: separation/initiator; civil court/date/number/status; restraining orders; reconciliation; previous permit applications; documents.
findings.implementation: Separation is disabled in council shell; backend case_detail lacks this projection.
findings.schema_mapping: application_separation_assertions, application_restraining_orders, application_prior_records and answers. Current adapter uses AnswerRevision.answers JSON.
findings.action: Build read projection and page. Render multiple orders/prior records and approved Unknown states. Do not restore rejected spouse lives-with requirements.

findings.title: Spouses page loses detailed profiles
findings.prototype: admin-case-parties.html:101-180: DOB, aliases, birth country, nationality, contact, immigration, education/graduation, occupation, church/parish/Father of Confession.
findings.implementation: council-case.js:2234 CaseParties shows name, CTM reference, registration badge and add-spouse form. api.py:469 case_detail provides only minimal party details.
findings.schema_mapping: person_identity_versions + application_person_assertions + answers/additional_facts. Current Person/Account/Party do not provide the complete council profile.
findings.action: Map each approved field to exact question code and retained answer source, then render attributed spouse profiles. Unconfirmed prototype-only fields need review; do not merge conflicting spouse accounts of a fact.

findings.title: Children missing from council overview
findings.prototype: admin-case-parties.html:191-215 and summary:251-255: repeated child names, DOB/age, gender and lives-with.
findings.implementation: CaseParties, CaseSummary and case_detail have no child projection.
findings.schema_mapping: application_children + stable repeat-entry identities; generic answers lists are only an adapter. Age is derived, not a stored timeless fact.
findings.action: Connect repeated children into Spouses/Summary with approved Unknown and per-source attribution.

findings.title: Summary lacks factual overview
findings.prototype: admin-case-summary.html:208-348: filing date, grounds, duration, last hearing, children, key dates.
findings.implementation: council-case.js:2649 CaseSummary shows operational state, assignee, spouses, proceeding, request counts and decision links, not the full factual summary.
findings.schema_mapping: Submissions, grounds, marriage assertions, children, hearings and lifecycle events already planned.
findings.action: Restore factual summary with authoritative dates and source links. Distinguish creation from filing and define duration endpoints.

findings.title: Timeline omits marriage/family chronology
findings.prototype: admin-case-timeline.html:79-81,115-120: Case/Marriage filters, church marriage, births, separation, divorce and counseling.
findings.implementation: CaseTimeline derives audit milestones and assignment history, not a full family chronology.
findings.schema_mapping: Assertion/repeat records plus lifecycle events. Event occurrence date is different from audit recorded_at.
findings.action: Add source-linked factual timeline and filters. Do not silently restore timeline export/rasterization.

findings.title: Cases/Archived lose queues and important columns
findings.prototype: admin-cases.html:118-159: My/Unassigned/Active/Closed/Incomplete/All tabs, spouses, last activity, filing date, grounds and outcome; admin-archived.html:81-87.
findings.implementation: council.js:2300 CasesTable shows case number, manager and open/closed status only. api.py:445 lacks richer row projection.
findings.schema_mapping: Case lifecycle, application completeness, assignments, party identity, grounds, submissions, decisions/decrees are distinct concepts.
findings.action: Restore server-backed queues/columns/filters; incomplete means formal returned/incomplete filing, never private unfinished drafts. No case delete or arbitrary close action.

findings.title: Pagination cannot reach all records
findings.prototype: Cases, Archived and historical-session browsing imply complete record access.
findings.implementation: api.py:445 cases and :594 sessions return only first100; DataTable pagination operates on that array.
findings.schema_mapping: No new business table: needs authorized query, count and stable cursor/filter contract.
findings.action: Implement server pagination and complete counts, test >100 cases/sessions and stable ordering.

findings.title: Advanced search is document-only and lacks filters
findings.prototype: admin-search.html:88-116: cases/people/documents/sessions, case ID/name/status/grounds/manager/document type/date range.
findings.implementation: council.js:2092 SearchWorkspace offers query/history only; backend search service queries ctm_documents, api accepts q/history/case_id.
findings.schema_mapping: search_documents supports source_kind/source_id/version/security scope; additional entity indexing/query projections missing.
findings.action: Restore unified authorized entity search and filters. Keep text in POST bodies, medical exclusions and source authorization on every result/snippet.

findings.title: Dashboard misses defined content
findings.prototype: admin-index.html:484-570,802-855; earlier approved dashboard plan also requires Outstanding Requests.
findings.implementation: CouncilHome:2207 has session dates, unread/review/consideration counts and own-case cards; no outstanding requests, previous summary, roster workload or recent submissions.
findings.schema_mapping: Requests, assignments, sessions and submissions exist conceptually; aggregate projections missing.
findings.action: Complete functional dashboard in Plenix and conduct actual visual review. Do not copy prototype CSS or hardcoded metrics.

findings.title: Statistics is only basic operational counts
findings.prototype: admin-reports.html:77-103; admin-index.html:579-790: period, case volume/status/grounds/outcomes/workload/durations and demographic breakdowns.
findings.implementation: council.js:2368 StatisticsWorkspace computes limited open/closed/unassigned/member/session counts over max100 rows.
findings.schema_mapping: Most source facts already planned. No obligatory analytics table; period/denominator definitions required.
findings.action: Implement full server aggregates and period filters. Outcome proportions can be valid with defined cohort; do not call tribunal demographics population divorce rates or imply causation.

findings.title: Council member detail/history page absent
findings.prototype: admin-member.html:132-184: member ID/contact, active assigned cases and past cases.
findings.implementation: No member-detail workspace; roster API is not equivalent to member historical workload view.
findings.schema_mapping: staff_memberships/roles, accounts, case_assignments. Past workload cannot be reconstructed from current assigned_member alone.
findings.action: Provide member profile/current/past cases with retained assignment history and bounded queries.

findings.title: System management UI mostly absent
findings.prototype: admin-management.html:191-250,317-470: staff lifecycle, tribunal settings, grounds/stages/outcomes, template library/editor.
findings.implementation: Generic settings API allows six keys; enrollment/authority routes exist but no equivalent comprehensive system administration workspace.
findings.schema_mapping: Staff tables, ground_definitions, decision_types, document_categories, questionnaire/declaration/template/setting/integration versions.
findings.action: Build system-level management, not case-member authority. Existing-admin-only council creation and later fixed permission rules supersede generic role toggles.

findings.title: Previous members/login sessions/security views incomplete
findings.prototype: admin-management.html:239-250,280-301,529-599: departed members, login result/IP/device, session revocation and audit filters.
findings.implementation: Active-account flag, partial membership dates and generic audit are not full lifecycle/login/session interfaces.
findings.schema_mapping: staff memberships/roles, account_events, app_sessions/identities; provider login events require explicit integration.
findings.action: Define CTM vs provider-session/log sources and safe retention, expose authorized history/revocation. No local password system.

findings.title: My Account profile is a stub
findings.prototype: admin-user-account.html:113-157,197-276: photo/title/name/phone/contact, role/appointment info, cases/activity.
findings.implementation: app.js:1521 Profile displays name and portal; Account Settings provides languages only. No full phone/photo profile adapter.
findings.schema_mapping: Identity/profile facts, staff memberships/roles and contextual photo ownership need exact mapping.
findings.action: Complete approved profile/contact and role/activity views; keep provider identity/email-change rules. Do not restore password/timeouts/SMS widgets.

findings.title: Session timing/location/presiding metadata lacks explicit storage
findings.prototype: admin-sessions-upcoming.html:125-130; admin-session-summary.html:83-86: time, presiding member, location and actual duration.
findings.implementation: CouncilSession stores date/state/closed_at; session API has date/reference/state/capabilities only.
findings.schema_mapping: Baseline council_sessions also lacks scheduled time/location/presiding snapshot. Testimony appointment location/time is not session metadata.
findings.action: Define session start/timezone/location and presiding reference/snapshot; clarify actual start/end. Append approved schema mapping/change rather than fabricate values.

findings.title: Session summary/minutes not complete
findings.prototype: admin-session-summary.html:91-150: totals, cases/outcomes/recommendations, attendance, minutes, recorder/approval and print.
findings.implementation: Closed agenda/hearing records exist; no dedicated equivalent minutes version/approval entity or full summary generator found.
findings.schema_mapping: Agenda/attendance/hearing outcomes support summary. No session_minutes entity in151 baseline.
findings.action: Compose retained-record summary. Editable minutes/approval require workflow/schema decision; prototype TBD is not approval. Printing is distinct from rejected exports.

findings.title: Historical session filters incomplete
findings.prototype: admin-sessions-historical.html:189-214 and admin-sessions.html:345-369: date/year, member, ground, outcome and totals.
findings.implementation: Split session list/closed workspace exist; no complete filtered/paged aggregate API.
findings.schema_mapping: Sessions, agenda, assignments, hearings and decisions supply sources.
findings.action: Add complete historical filters/counts and friendly date-based names; do not restore old sequence IDs.

findings.title: Interview event metadata only partly retained
findings.prototype: admin-case-intake.html:211-260: subject, actual interviewer, method, datetime/location/duration.
findings.implementation: Report has completion_date/method/author; structured actual location/duration/datetime not found. Recording duration is different.
findings.schema_mapping: reports baseline has completion_date/method, recordings duration. Explicit mapping needed for remaining approved interview facts.
findings.action: Reconcile interviewer vs recorder and event metadata. Owner later chose date sufficient for report naming, not necessarily deletion of event details.

findings.title: Call logging has narrower metadata/contact scope
findings.prototype: admin-case-communications.html:359-386: spouse/clergy contact, inbound/outbound, date, duration and notes.
findings.implementation: CallRecord requires Party and has occurred_at/outcome/notes; no explicit direction/duration or clergy contact.
findings.schema_mapping: call_details has contacted_person/call_at/outcome/notes; communications.direction could hold direction if adapter mapped.
findings.action: Document call-to-communication mapping and clarify clergy contact scope. No new dialing/automatic phone recording claim.

findings.title: Communication subject/external recipients/inbound reply coverage incomplete
findings.prototype: admin-case-communications.html:315-345: subject, spouse/clergy recipient and message history.
findings.implementation: Existing Message/Recipient and call UI do not establish full subject/thread/external-clergy/inbound integration.
findings.schema_mapping: communications.subject/channel/direction; recipients.external_email; reply_routes/inbound_receipts/attachment_returns planned.
findings.action: Map actual subject/thread/delivery contract; distinguish priest request invites from ordinary correspondence. Private spouse channels and contextual document links remain required.

findings.title: Case audit structured filters reduced
findings.prototype: admin-case-audit.html:96-101: action/user selectors and timestamp/action/user/target/description.
findings.implementation: CaseAudit offers free-text filtering; equivalent action/user/date structured controls absent.
findings.schema_mapping: audit_events source references and safe details already planned.
findings.action: Add useful authorized filters/pagination and safe actor/target context, preserving council vs system audit scope.

findings.title: Decree template authoring/generation missing
findings.prototype: admin-case-decree.html:378-416 and admin-management.html:408-470: preamble/findings/canonical basis/statement/conditions editor, signature and templates.
findings.implementation: Council decree UI uploads signed PDF, records signature, issues and releases; notes explicitly state generation unavailable.
findings.schema_mapping: decree_template_versions/certificates/issuance/entitlements/releases planned; current smaller model adapter not fully equivalent.
findings.action: Complete approved versioned type-specific EN/AR/bilingual certificate authoring/generation. Institutional wording remains blocked; no sample doctrine treated as approved.

findings.title: Issued decree structured read needs reconciliation
findings.prototype: admin-case-decree-view.html:233-405: metadata, tally/member votes, narrative sections, signature and PDF.
findings.implementation: Votes/decision/decree details exist across separate destinations; structured narrative preview/generation absent.
findings.schema_mapping: Decision/votes/approval and exact signed PDF/template provenance, not duplicate free-editable certificate facts.
findings.action: Map existing destinations before duplicating; provide source-linked read view while exact signed certificate remains authoritative.

findings.title: Contextual documents not connected to missing factual pages
findings.prototype: Marriage:144-162, Separation:261-279, Requisition:108-126 plus Evidence/Documents split views.
findings.implementation: Global viewers and file contexts exist; no Marriage/Separation view to host their exact category/context files.
findings.schema_mapping: files + file_context_links + repeat/question context + exact versions/manifests; current Attachment.context is a string adapter.
findings.action: Map stable contexts and render latest permitted versions in correct locations. Multiple links must not require copying originals.

findings.title: Historical case entry lacks full council UI
findings.prototype: admin-cases.html:88 Create a Case; owner later approved special historical entry with missing facts/no fee.
findings.implementation: Backend historical_stage/publish and workspace exist; no complete historical-entry workspace in council module inventory.
findings.schema_mapping: historical_entry_workspaces, preserved original identifiers and unavailable facts.
findings.action: Add authorized system-level entry, open/closed selection and original IDs without bypassing ordinary applicant requirements.

findings.title: Full schema equivalence not demonstrated
findings.prototype: Detailed pages versus151-table approved contract; not a one-page/one-table exercise.
findings.implementation: Pinned backend has63 model classes/aggregate adapters; JSON stores several normalized concepts. Counts alone prove neither data loss nor equivalence.
findings.schema_mapping: Need per-column mapping to model/JSON path, type, validation, repeat ID, history, RLS, provenance and query/index semantics.
findings.action: Create explicit equivalence register; migrations only for unsupported semantics after review. Do not replace approved schema to match adapter.

findings.title: Application-to-council field coverage not proven
findings.prototype: All spouse/marriage/separation/repeat labels; build-spec requires accepted AF wording and repeat details.
findings.implementation: Generic renderer/report question bank is not proof published petition definition includes every approved field. Report questions are not application intake.
findings.schema_mapping: Questionnaire code -> assertion/answer JSON path -> formal revision -> council projection, with exact EN/AR/Unknown requirements.
findings.action: Register each prototype field and later disposition; identify omitted codes vs stored-but-unshown values. Do not silently add unapproved prototype-only questions.

findings.title: Page completion needs seven-stage evidence
findings.prototype: All business pages and later Reports/Appeals/Assessments workflows.
findings.implementation: Named screen/fixture-tested component was conflated with full working and visual acceptance. Separate branches are not localhost integration.
findings.schema_mapping: Delivery governance, no new business entity.
findings.action: Track Workflow/Schema/Database/Coded/Working/UI/QA per capability, with source/runtime/visual evidence separately.

findings.title: Dynamic controls must remain requirements evidence
findings.prototype: admin-cases.html:118-159 inline tabs/actions and shared prototype app.js; design previews separate.
findings.implementation: Static headings alone miss operational tabs, fields and state-dependent actions.
findings.schema_mapping: Map destinations/actions/roles, not literal old navigation or CSS.
findings.action: Keep functional coverage while excluding purge/export/password/old-stage shortcuts; prototype scripts are not normative permission logic.
